{{dablink|For other uses of the word "wind," see [[Wind]].}}

'''Windbiter's Finger''' is a substantial peninsula extending several hundred miles into the sea from the [[Shadow Coast]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Windbiter's Finger}} It marks the point where the [[Aryth Ocean]] meets the [[Sea of Storms]]. The peninsula is ragged and semi-submerged in places, and is dangerous to shipping. The [[Sea Folk]] and other traders use it as a navigational marker, but do not travel too close to it.
